description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Notice of the meeting in Kinniya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the summoning of a meeting to fill vacancies for Chairman and Vice Chairman positions in a local authority (Kinniya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and Amendment Act. It deals with electoral processes at the local government level, specifically addressing vacancies and the election of officials, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7).
